reason: A conversation-integrated Kanban plugin whose primary purpose is agent-assisted project planning and execution through workspace-specific boards, persistent cards, and a browser UI.

summaries.zh: 在对话中提供按工作区隔离的看板，用于让智能体和用户创建、组织并跟踪项目计划卡片。
summaries.en: Provides workspace-specific Kanban boards for agents and users to create, organize, and track project planning cards within conversations.

capabilities: Registers agent tools to create, update, organize, move, restore, and delete Kanban cards and columns
Provides a browser-based Kanban board interface with filtering, search, ordering, labels, priorities, due dates, and bulk operations
Persists board data to workspace-specific JSON files on disk
Exposes a local web API route for the browser interface
